description: This file contains implementation of mathematical operations for Rational numbers, including functions for fractional parts, integer parts, power, root, factorial, exponential, logarithms, trigonometric functions, hyperbolic functions, inverse functions, and modulus, utilizing external C functions and internal Rational class methods.

classes.name: RationalMath
classes.description: A class providing static methods for various mathematical operations on Rational numbers.

methods.name: Frac
methods.description: Returns the fractional part of a Rational number.

methods.name: Integer
methods.description: Returns the integer part of a Rational number.

methods.name: Pow
methods.description: Calculates the power of a Rational base raised to a Rational exponent.

methods.name: Root
methods.description: Calculates the root of a Rational number.

methods.name: Fact
methods.description: Calculates the factorial of a Rational number.

methods.name: Exp
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of a Rational number.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of a Rational number.

methods.name: Log10
methods.description: Calculates the base-10 logarithm of a Rational number.

methods.name: Invert
methods.description: Returns the reciprocal of a Rational number.

methods.name: Abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of a Rational number.

methods.name: Sin
methods.description: Calculates the sine of a Rational angle, given the angle type.

methods.name: Cos
methods.description: Calculates the cosine of a Rational angle, given the angle type.

methods.name: Tan
methods.description: Calculates the tangent of a Rational angle, given the angle type.

methods.name: ASin
methods.description: Calculates the arcsine of a Rational number, given the angle type.

methods.name: ACos
methods.description: Calculates the arccosine of a Rational number, given the angle type.

methods.name: ATan
methods.description: Calculates the arctangent of a Rational number, given the angle type.

methods.name: Sinh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic sine of a Rational number.

methods.name: Cosh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic cosine of a Rational number.

methods.name: Tanh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic tangent of a Rational number.

methods.name: ASinh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic sine of a Rational number.

methods.name: ACosh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a Rational number.

methods.name: ATanh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a Rational number.

methods.name: Mod
methods.description: Calculates the modulus after division of two Rational numbers, with sign matching the second operand.
